# AWS Chaos Engineering Framework 2.0.4

Version 2.0.4 corrects the package maturity metadata. The previous PyPI upload carried a Beta development-status classifier that was not supported by a documented maturity decision. This release omits that classifier. Runtime behavior and safety gates are unchanged from 2.0.3.

The release contains an exact standalone runtime, wheel, normalized source archive, SPDX SBOM, SHA-256 checksums, and commit-bound release evidence. The tag workflow creates a draft from a verified protected-main commit and attests every asset. PyPI upload remains a separate protected trusted-publishing workflow.

Plan mode remains the default. Live execution requires explicit CLI intent, exact account and region binding, target controls, alarms, and confirmation tokens. The release gate does not use AWS credentials or contact an AWS account. Use this software only in isolated, non-production environments you own or are authorized to test.
